description: Improves typography in an existing UI: font choice and pairing, a consistent type scale, weight contrast, hierarchy, line length, line-height, letter-spacing and font loading. Use when the user mentions fonts, type or readability, says text hierarchy or sizing looks off, uses default fonts like Inter or Roboto, or wants more intentional typography. Not for spacing and grid fixes (use ui-layout-spacing).
